slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single batch be split across multiple vats, or must each batch be processed entirely in exactly one vat?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched whether a batch uses multiple vats, but never asked whether all batches must visit vat 1, then vat 2, then vat 3 in a fixed sequence. The final model instead treats the problem as unrelated parallel machines.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each batch is processed entirely on exactly one vat, so there is no required fixed vat sequence of vat 1 -> vat 2 -> vat 3.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the hidden vat-sequence constraint; it asked only about splitting/one-vat processing and then assumed a parallel-machine structure in READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped while the P1 vat-sequence constraint remained unresolved and then presented a model assuming each batch is assigned to one vat only.

summary: The agent clarified several scheduling details, but it failed to recover the fixed vat-sequence constraint and stopped prematurely with a parallel-machine model. H1 was only partially touched and then silently assumed away.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
